title: A degenerate Whittaker criterion for $\mathrm GL_{2n}$
summary: Let $F$ be a non-Archimedean local field. Let $N$ be the unipotent radical of the standard parabolic subgroup of $\mathrm GL_{2n}(F)$ of type $(n,n)$ with fixed nondegenerate additive character $ψ$. For an irreducible admissible representation $π$ of $\mathrm GL_{2n}(F)$, a theorem due to Gomez--Gourevitch--Sahi on generalized Whittaker models gives a criterion for the vanishing of the twisted Jacquet module $π_{N,ψ}$ in terms of the wave-front set.
